description: Every .cook name listed for sale on the CookOven domain marketplace, read straight from the program — no indexer, no key needed. Filter by `name` (substring match), `seller`, `maxPriceCook` or `maxLength` (short names are the scarce ones), and sort by 'price' (cheapest first), 'length' or 'recent' (default). Also returns the live marketplace fee, which the SELLER pays out of the sale price, and the floor price of the matched set. Use resolve_domain for one specific name, or register_domain for a name nobody owns yet — the market only holds names that are already registered.

maxLength.description: only names with at most this many characters

maxPriceCook.description: only listings at or below this price in COOK

name.description: only listings whose name contains this text (the .cook suffix is ignored)

seller.description: only listings from this wallet address or .cook name

sort.description: price = cheapest first, length = shortest first, recent = newest first (default)

name: get_domain_listings
title: Browse .cook names for sale
